findings.reason: Reviewed application has no servlet-container security constraints; access control uses the Spring Security allowlist.
Reviewed application does not configure Tomcat DIGEST authentication.
Reviewed application does not configure Tomcat FORM authentication or container method-specific security constraints.
Reviewed application accepts no typed JSON request bodies; its Jackson usage reads trusted manifest data into a tree without string-to-number coercion.
Reviewed application does not create a JSON parser from DataInput; trusted manifest parsing uses InputStream.
Reviewed application does not deserialize untrusted JSON into XML Duration or XMLGregorianCalendar values.
Reviewed application has no name-based polymorphic JSON binding or defaultImpl fallback accepting untrusted type identifiers.
Reviewed application has no identity-enabled JSON collection/map deserialization or JsonIdentityInfo bindings.
